And the way grows weary and long.
Does Jesus care when my way is dark,
With a nameless dread and fear?
As the daylight fades, Into deep night shades,
Does He care enough to be near?
Does Jesus care when I’ve tried and failed,
To resist some temptation strong?
When in my deep grief I find no relief,
Tho’ my tears flow all the night long?
Does Jesus care when I’ve said “good-by”
To the dearest on earth to me,
And my sad heart aches, ‘Till it nearly breaks,
Is this aught to Him? Does He see?
englishChorus: O yes, He cares, I know He cares,
His heart is touched with my grief;
When the days are weary,
The long nights dreary,
I know my Saviour  cares (He cares)

title: Linda Usadandaule
writer: William H. Bellamy / William J. Kirkpatrick
verses: Walemedwa ndi katundu, Wa zinthu za dziko lino,
M’njira muli minga kodi, Iye anabvala minga;
Wapeza cisoni kodi, Iye cinamgwera kale.
englishVerses: The home where changes never come,
Nor pain nor sorrow, toil nor care;
Yes! ‘tis a bright and blessed home;
Who would not fain be resting there?
Yet when bowed down beneath the load,
By heaven allowed, thine earthly lot,
Thou yearn’st to reach that blest abode,
Wait, meekly wait, and murmur not.
If in thy path some thorns are found,
O, think who bore them on His brow;
If grief thy sorrowing heart has found,
It reached a holier than thou.
Toil on, nor deem, though sore it be,
One sigh unheard, one prayer forgot;
The day of rest will dawn for thee,
Wait, meekly wait, and murmur not.
englishChorus: O, wait, (meekly wait)
meekly wait and murmur not,
O, wait, (meekly wait)
meekly wait and murmur not,
O, wait, (meekly wait) O, wait, (meekly wait)
O, wait, and murmur not. (O murmur not)

title: Sindiri Ndekha
writer: C. F. O. / V. A. White (Christ in Song)
verses: Ndekha? Bi, sindiri ndekha Yesu ngwanga;
Ulibe bwenzi ko, Ndiri naye Yesu;
Pa dzanja lace Yesu phe Andisamalira.
englishVerses: Lonely? No, not lonely,
While Jesus standeth by;
His presence always cheers me;
I know that he is nigh,
Friend-less? No, not friend-less,
For Jesus is my Friend;
I change, but he remaineth,
The same unto the end.
Weary? No, not weary,
While leaning on his breast;
My soul hath full enjoyment,
In His eternal rest;
Helpless? Yes, so helpless;
But I am leaning hard;
On the mighty arm of Jesus,
And he is keeping guard.
Waiting? Yes, I’m waiting;
He bids me watch and wait,
I only wonder often,
What makes my Lord so late,
Joyful? Yes, so joyful,
With joy too deep for words;
A precious, sure foundation,
The joy that is my Lord’s.
englishChorus: No, never alone, -- no, never alone;
He has promised never to leave me,
Never to leave me alone
No, never alone, -- no, never alone;
He has promised never to leave me,
Never to leave me alone

title: Cinthu Cina Kwa Yesu
scripture: Abena Roma 12:1 · 2 Abena Korinte 5:14-15 · 1 Yohane 4:19 · Luka 9:23
englishVerses: Saviour! Thy dying love, Thou gavest me,
Nor shall I aught withhold, Dear lord, from Thee;
In love my soul would bow,
My heart fulfill its vow,
Some offering bring Thee now,
Something for Thee
At the blest mercy seat, Pleading for me,
My feeble faith looks up, Jesus to Thee;
Help me the cross to bear,
Thy wondrous love declare,
Some song to raise or prayer,
Something for Thee.
Give me a faithful heart, Likeness to Thee,
That each departing day, henceforth may see;
Some work of love begun,
Some deed of kindness done,
Some wand’rer sought and won,
Something for Thee.
All that I am and have, Thy gifts so free,
In joy, in grief, through life, Dear Lord for Thee;
And when Thy face I see,
My ransomed and shall be,
Through all eternity, Something for Thee.

title: Maziko Amodzi
writer: Samuel J. Stone / Samuel S. Wesley
scripture: Abena Efese 2:19-22 · Abena Efese 4:4-6 · 1 Abena Korinte 3:11 · Ukusokolola 21:2
verses: Maziko a mpingo amodzi ndi Kristu;
Colenga catsopano, mwa madzi ndi mau;
Wokwanira mitundu yonse ya pa dziko;
M’kati mwa masauko a mpingo woyera;
englishVerses: The Church has one foundation,
‘Tis Jesus Christ her Lord;
She is His new creation,
By water and by word,
From heav’n He came and sought her,
To be His holly bride,
With His own blood He bought her,
And for her life He died.
Elect from every nation,
Yet one o’er all the earth,
Her charter of salvation,
One Lord, One faith, one birth;
One holy name she blesses,
Partakes one holy food,
And to one hope she presses,
With every grace endued.
Though with a scornful wonder,
Men see her sore opprest,
Though foes would rend asunder,
The Rock where she doth rest;
Yet saints their faith are keeping,
Their cry goes up “How long?”
And soon the night of weeping,
Shall be morn of song.
‘Mid toil and tribulation,
And tumult of her war,
She waits the consummation,
Of peace for evermore;
Till with the vision glorious,
Her longing eyes are blest,
And the great Church victorious,
Shall be the Church at rest.

title: Mudnitsogolere Yehova
writer: Guide Me O T Hou Great Jehovah
englishTune: Guide Me O T Hou Great Jehovah
verses: Ntaponda gombe la Yordan, Mantha mundicotsere;
Ndioloke tsidya ilo, Komwe kuli cimwemwe

title: Kwathu
writer: Hugh R. Haweis / George C. Stebbins
verses: Ndiri kulira kwathu, Mtima suli bwino;
englishVerses: The Homeland! O the Homeland!
The land of the freeborn!
There’s no night in the Homeland,
But aye the fadeless morn;
I’m sighing for the Homeland,
My heart is aching here;
There is no pain in the Homeland,
To which I’m drawing near;
There is no pain in the Homeland,
To which I’m drawing near.
My Lord is in the Homeland,
With angels bright and fair;
There’s no sin the Homeland,
And no temptation there;
The music of the Homeland,
Is ringing in my ears;
And when I think of the Homeland,
My eyes are filled with tears;
And when I think of the Homeland,
My eyes are filled with tears.
The dwellers in the Homeland,
Are beck’ning me to come,
Where neither death nor sorrow
Invades their holy home;
O dear, dear native country!
O rest and peace above!
Christ bring us all to the Homeland,
Of Thy redeeming love;
Christ bring us all to the Homeland,
Of Thy redeeming love.

title: M’manja A Yesu Wanga
writer: Fanny J. Crosby / William H. Doane
englishTune: Safe In The Arms Of Jesus
verses: M’manja a Yesu wanga ndiri kugonamo,
Mvera! Mudzera mmwamba mau a Yesu wanga,
M’manja a Yesu wanga nkhawa zonsezi zi!
Mommo mulibe nsoni, mommo mokoma monse.
Sindiliramo msozi, nkondwa ndi Mtima wonse.
Mommo wa cete ine mpaka wocoka mdima,
Tsono ndiona komwe Yesu wokoma Mtima.
chorus: M’manja a Yesu wanga ndiri kugonamo,
englishVerses: Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe on gentle breast,
Here by love o’er shaded,
Sweetly my soul doth rest,
Hark! ‘tis the voice of angels,
Borne in a song to me,
Over the fields of glory,
Over the jasper sea.
Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe from corroding care;
Safe from the world’s temptations,
Sin cannot harm me there.
Free from the blight of sorrow,
Free from my doubts and fears;
Only a few more trials,
Only a few more tears.
Jesus, my heart’s dear refuge,
Jesus, has died for me;
Firm on the Rock of Ages,
Ever my trust shall be.
Here let me wait with patience,
Wait till the night is o’er;
Wait till I see the morning,
Break on the golden shore.
englishChorus: Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe on his gentle breast,
Hear by his love o’er shaded,
Sweetly my soul doth rest.

title: Niddzatsata Konseko
writer: Elisha A. Hoffman / John S. Norris
verses: Ndimva Mpulumutsi wanga, Mwa cifuno andi’tana
Ndimva mau ace ati, "Unditsate  tsate konseko
Njira ide mdilma bwanji, Mapazi atope bwanji;
Mobvuta antsogolera, Ndidya mana a kumwamba;
englishVerses: I can hear my Saviour calling,
In the tend’rest accents calling;
On my ear these words are falling,
Come and follow, daily follow me.
Though the way be dark and dreary,
Though my feet be worn and weary;
Yet my heart keeps bright and cheery,
As I follow, follow all the way.
Jesus, ever go before me,
Shining heaven’s sunlight o’er me,
And when weak, by grace restore me,
As I follow, follow all the way.
Through the valley safely lead me,
Heav’nly manna daily feed me;
Every hour, dear Lord, I need thee,
As I follow, follow all the way.
In thy heart’s affection hold me,
In thy arms of love enfold me;
And with thine own grace uphold me,
As I follow, follow all the way.
englishChorus: I will take my cross and follow,
My dear Saviour I will follow;
Where he leads I will follow,
I’ll go with him, with him all the way.

title: Nyali Yanu Iwalire
englishTune: Let The Lower Lights Be Burning
verses: Kuli mdima m’dziko lino, Ndi namondwe wa bvuto,
Konza nyali yako msanga, Pena wobvutikayo
chorus: Kwa ocimwa ndi ofo’ka, Njira yonka m’Mwambamo.
englishVerses: Brightly beams our Father’s mercy,
From His light-house ever more,
But to us He gives the keeping,
Of the lights along the shore.
Dark the night of sin has settled,
Loud the angry billows roar;
Eager eyes are watching, longing,
For the lights along the shore.
Trim your feeble lamp, my brother;
Some poor sailor tempest-tost;
Trying now to make the harbor,
In the darkness may be lost.
englishChorus: Let the lower lights be burning!
Send a gleam across the wave!
Some poor fainting, struggling seaman,
You may rescue, you may save.

title: Uyang’ane Mdaniyo
writer: Fanny J. Crosby / William B. Bradbury & Philip Phillips
englishVerses: O Christian, awake! ‘tis the Master’s command;
With helmet and shield, and a sword in thy hand,
To meet the bold tempter, go, fearlessly go,
And stand like the brave, with thy face to the foe.
Whatever thy danger, take heed and be-ware,
And turn not thy back, for no armor is there;
The legions of darkness, if thou wouldst o’er-throw,
Then stand like the brave, with thy face to the foe.
The cause of thy Master with vigor defend;
Be watchful, be zealous, and fight to the end;
Wherever he leads thee, go, valiantly go,
And stand like the brave, with thy face to the foe.
Press on, never doubting, thy Captain is near,
With grace to supply, and with comfort to cheer;
His love, like a stream in the desert will flow,
Then stand like the brave, with thy face to the foe.
englishChorus: Stand like the brave, stand like the brave,
Stand like the brave, with thy face to the foe.

title: Pafupi Kukopeka
englishVerses: Almost persuaded now to believe,
Almost persuaded Christ to receive;
Seems now some soul to say,
“Go, Spirit, go Thy way,
Some more convenient day,
On Thee I’ll call.”
Almost persuaded, come, come, today;
Almost persuaded; turn not away,
Jesus invites you here,
Angels are lingering near,
Prayers rise from hearts so dear;
O wanderer come!
Almost persuaded; harvest is past!
Almost persuaded; doom comes at last!
“Almost” can not avail, “Almost” is but to fail!
Sad, sad that bitter wail-“Almost, - but lost!”

title: Pa Mtanda
scripture: 1 Petro 1:18-19 · Abena Galatia 6:14 · Abena Roma 5:8 · Abena Efese 1:7
verses: Ambuye mwazi nakhetsa, Mfumu yanga nifa,
Anabuula pa mtengo, Ndi zoipa zanga;
chorus: Pa mtanda, pa mtanda ndaona kuwala,
englishVerses: Alas! And did my Saviour bleed,
And did my Sovereign die?
Would he devote that sacred head,
For such a worm as I?
Was it for deeds that I have done,
He groaned upon the tree?
Amazing pity, grace unknown,
And love beyond degree!
But drops of grief can ne’er repay,
The debt of love I owe;
Here, Lord, I give myself away,
‘Tis all that I can do!
englishChorus: At the cross, at the cross,
where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my heart
rolled away (rolled away)
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the way.

title: Muyamikeni Yesu
writer: Fanny J. Crosby / Chester G. Allen
verses: Mphavu ndi ulemu ndi za Yesu.
englishVerses: Praise Him! Praise Him!
Jesus, our blessed Redeemer!
Sing, O earth, His wonderful love proclaim!
Hail Him! Hail Him!
Highest arch-angels in glory;
Strength and honor give to His holy name!
Like a shepherd, Jesus will guard His children,
In His arms He carries them all day long;
Praise Him! Praise Him! Jesus, our blessed Redeemer!
For our sins He suffered, and bled and died;
He our Rock, our hope of eternal salvation,
Hail Him! Hail Him! Jesus the crucified.
Sound His praises! Jesus who bore our sorrows,
Love unbounded, wonderful, deep and strong;
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Jesus, our blessed Redeemer!
Heav’nly portals, loud with hosannas ring!
Jesus, Saviour, reigneth forever and ever;
Crown Him! Crown Him!
Prophet, and Priest, and King!
Christ is coming, over the world victorious,
Power and glory, unto the Lord belong!
englishChorus: Praise Him! Praise Him!
Tell of His excellent greatness;
Praise Him! Praise Him ever in joyful song!

title: Wa Yesuyo Ndani?
chorus: Sankha, sankha (Wa Yesuyo ndani? Wa Yesuyo ndani?)

title: Ndine Njira
verses: Kwa Kristu, njira, co’nadi Ndi moyo ndibweranso;
chorus: Ndine njira, ndine njira, ndine njira co’nadi, moo
Ndine njira, ndine njira, ndine njira co’nadi, moyo
englishVerses: Like wandering sheep o’er mountains cold, Since all have gone astray;       To “Life” and peace within the fold, How may I find the way?
Bewildered oft with doubt and care,
To God I fain would go;
While many cry ”Lo here! Lo there!”
The truth how may I know?
To Christ the Way, the Truth, the Life,
I come, no more to roam;
He’ll guide me to my “Father’s house”
To my eternal home.
englishChorus: I  … am the way, … the truth,  and the life; ………….
(I am the way)        I am the way)
(I am the way, the truth and the life)
No man cometh unto the Father but by Me;
I …am the way, ……the truth, ……….and the life; ………
(I am the way)        (I am the way)
(I am the way, the truth and the life)
No man comes unto the Father but by me.

title: Lowetsa Yesu Mu Mtima
englishTune: Let Jesus Come Into Your Heart
verses: Kodi watopa nazo zoipa, Lowetsa Yesu mu Mtima;
Ngati ufuna kutembenuka, Lowetsa Yesu mu Mtima.
Ukafuna kukhala woyera, Lowetsa Yesu mu Mtima;
Madzi osamba ali pafupi, Lowetsa Yesu mu Mtima.
Ngati muli bvuto mtimamo, Lowetsa Yesu mu Mtima;
Ngati wapereweza za m’dziko, Lowetsa Yesu mu Mtima.
Abwenzi akakusandukira, Lowetsa Yesu mu Mtima;
Ndiye bwenzi losatekeseka, Lowetsa Yesu mu Mtima.
Ngati uyimba nao odala, Lowetsa Yesu mu Mtima;
Udzalowe m’nyumba za mpumulo, Lowetsa Yesu mu Mtima.
chorus: Tsegula Mtima wako; Lowetsa Yesu mu Mtima.
englishVerses: If you are tired of the load of your sin,
Let Jesus come into your heart;
If you desire a new life to begin,
Let Jesus come into your heart.
If ‘tis for purity now that you sigh,
Let Jesus come into your heart;
Fountains for cleansing are flowing near by,
Let Jesus come into your heart.
If there’s a tempest your voice cannot still,
Let Jesus come into your heart;
If there’s a void this world  never can fill,
Let Jesus come into your heart.
If friends, once trusted, have proven untrue,
Let Jesus come into your heart;
Find what a Friend He will be unto you,
Let Jesus come into your heart.
If you would join the songs of the blest,
Let Jesus come into your heart;
If you would enter the mansions of rest,
Let Jesus come into your heart.
englishChorus: Just now, your doubtings give o’er;
Just now reject Him no more;
Just now, throw open the door;
Let Jesus come into your heart.

title: Sindidzakusiya
verses: Ndzatsogola ndzakusunga, Mongwa mwa dzina langa;
Mphepo zikaomba mkuntho, upemphere kwa Ine;
Ndidzakhala nawe ndithu, Ndi kuti usacimwe.
Ngati ndadodometsedwa, Ndi nkhawa ndi cisoni,
Mbendera yokwezekayi, Ya cikondi canga njo.
englishVerses: I will never, never leave thee,
I will never thee forsake;
I will guide, and save, and keep thee,
For my name and mercy’s sake;
Fear no evil, Fear no evil,
Only all my counsel take.
When the storm is raging round thee,
Call on me in humble prayer;
I will fold my arms around thee,
Guard thee with the tend’rest care;
In the trial, In the trial,
I will make thy pathway clear.
When the storm is raging round thee,
Call on me in humble prayer;
I will fold my arms around thee,
Guard thee with the tend’rest care;
In the trial, In the trial,
I will make thy pathway clear.
When thy soul is dark and clouded,
Filled with doubt, and grief and care;
Through the mists by which ‘tis shrouded,
I will make the light appear,
And the banner, and the banner,
Of my love I will appear

title: Uzeni Nthano Yakale
writer: A. Katherine Hankey / William H. Doane
englishTune: Tell Me The Old, Old Story
verses: Uze nthano yakale, Ya za kumwambako,
Za Yesu wacifundo, Za Yesu wokonda;
Nenatu yomwe ija, Ukhala ndi mantha,
chorus: Nthano yakale uze, Nthano yakale uze,
Nthano yakale uze, Ya Yesu wokonda.
englishVerses: Tell me the old, old story, Of unseen things above,
Of Jesus and His glory, Of Jesus and His love.
Tell me the story simply, As to a little child,
For I am weak and weary, And helpless and defiled.
Tell me the story slowly, That I may take it in,That wonderful redemption, God’s remedy for sin.       Tell me the story often, For I forget so soon;The early dew of morning, Has passed away at noon.

Tell me the same old story, When you have cause to fear,That this world’s empty glory,Is costing me too dear,       Yes, and when that world’s glory,Is dawning on my soul, Tell me the old, old story,Christ Jesus makes thee whole.
englishChorus: Tell me the old, old story, Tell me the old, old story,       Tell me the old, old story,Of Jesus and His love.

title: Yesu Nyali Ya Dziko
writer: Jesus The Light Of The Word
englishTune: Jesus The Light Of The Word
verses: Ha! Nayimba angelo, Yesu nyali ya dziko;
Mwana wabadwa Mfumu, Yesu nyali ya dziko.
Mapfukonu kondwani, Yesu nyali ya dziko;
Kondwani ndi a m’mwamba, Yesu nyali ya dziko.
M’mwamba amlekeza, Yesu nyali ya dziko;
Yesu Mbuye wosatha, Yesu nyali ya dziko.
Mfumu ya mtenderedi, Yesu nyali ya dziko;
Dzuwa la cilungamo, Yesu nyali ya dziko.

title: Ladzanso Tsiku Lakupumula
englishVerses: Again the day returns of holy rest,
Which, when he made the world, Jehovah blest;
When, like his own, he bade our labor’s case,
And all be piety, and all be peace.
Let us devote this consecrated day,
To learn his will, and all we learn obey;
So shall he hear, when fervently we raise,
Our supplications, and our songs of praise.
Lord of all worlds, incline thy gracious ear;
Thy children’s voice in tender mercy hear;
Bear thy blest promise, fixed as hills, in mind,
And shed renewing grace on lost mankind.
Father in heaven in whom our hopes confide,
Whose power defends us, and whose precepts guide;
Through life our surest guardian, and friend,
Glory supreme be thine till time shall end.

title: Cifundo Cace
verses: Dzuka moyo wanga kondwa, Yimbira cipulumutso;
Moyo wanga asungabe; cifundo cace, Ncamphamvu!
Bvuto loda ngati mtambo, Lasonkhana ligundira,
Aima pafupi nane; Cifuno cace, Ncokoma!
Mwini Mfumu akadzadza, Kudzatenga anthu ace,
Ndikayimba pa tsikulo Cifundo cace, Kosatha!
englishVerses: Awake, my soul, to joyful lays,
And sing thy great Redeemer’s praise;
He justly claims a song from me,
His loving kindness, O how free!
Loving kindness, loving kindness,
His loving kindness O how free!
He saw me ruined in the fall,
Yet loved me notwithstanding all;
He saved me from my lost estate,
His loving kindness O how great!
Loving kindness, loving kindness,
His loving kindness O how great!
Though num’rous hosts of mighty foes,
Though earth and hell my way oppose,
He safely leads my soul along,
His loving kindness O how strong!
Loving kindness, loving kindness,
His loving kindness O how strong!
When trouble, like a gloomy cloud,
Has gathered thick and thundered loud,
He near my soul has always stood,
His loving kindness, O how good!
Loving kindness, loving kindness,
His loving kindness O how good!

title: Akristu Limbikani!
writer: George Duffield Jr. / George J. Webb
englishTune: Stand Up! Stand Up For Jesus!
verses: Wotsogolera wathu ndi Mwana wa Mulungu;
Tigwire nkhondo yomwe ya Mbuye wathuyo;
englishVerses: Stand up, stand up for Jesus, ye soldiers of the cross;
Lift high His royal banner, it must not suffer loss.
From vict’ry unto vict’ry His army shall He lead,
Till ev’ry foe is vanquished, and Christ is Lord indeed.
Stand up, stand up for Jesus, the trumpet call obey;
Forth to the mighty conflict, in this His glorious day.
Ye that are brave now serve Him against unnumbered foes;
Let courage rise with danger, and strength to strength oppose.
Stand up, stand up for Jesus, stand in His strength alone;
The arm of flesh will fail you, ye dare not trust your own.
Put on the gospel armor, each piece put on with prayer;
Where duty calls or danger, be never wanting there.
Stand up, stand up for Jesus, the strife will not be long;
This day the noise of battle, the next the victor’s song.
To him that overcometh a crown of life shall be;
He with the King of Glory shall reign eternally.

title: Akulowa M’zipata
verses: Awa ndani pa tsidya la Nyanja, Omwe payola manda acetu,
Akondwera mwa Yesu? Asamba m’mwazi Wace.
Awa ndiwo anapeza Yesu, Pamene anali anyamata,
Awa ndiwo mansautso yao, Anapeza kupuma mwa Yesu,
Mtendere mu mtimamo, Asamba m’mwazi Wace.
Iwo adapirira mabvuto, Anapyola pakati pa moto:
Yesu ati idzani, Asamba m’mwazi Wace.

title: Kodi Uli Kulemedwa?
verses: Kodi ali ndi cilemba m’mphumi mwacemo?

title: Pakhomo
verses: Akulangiza ugule Golide yo ndi Cobvala;
Dzoza maso, muonetu, Ucotse zonyasa zako.
Mvera mau a umboni Ati usanke wacedwa;
Uli wonyoza, wofunda! Khala cangu usanduke.
Wonynsa anyansebe tu, Woyera akhalebe conco.
Lonyowa tsitsi ndi mame, Cifukwa akukondadi,
Mwa ciyanjano cokoma Ndzadye naye, Iye nane.
englishVerses: Behold the Saviour at the door!
He gently knocks, has knocked before,
Has waited long, is waiting still,
You treat no other friend so ill.
He counsels thee to buy of him,
Gold tried by fire, and raiment clean;
Anoint thine eyes, that thou may’st see,
And put away thy stains from thee.
O, hear the faithful Witness’ voice,
He offers now a final choice;
Thou art offensive, O lukewarm!
Therefore be zealous and reform.
His mission now is almost o’er,
Before the throne he’ll plead no more;
The filthy must his filth retain,
He that is holy, so remain
His locks with dews of night are wet,
But at thy heart he ling’reth yet;
Awake! And open wide the door;
Bid thy Beloved wait no more.
Yes, bring him in, a welcome guest;
So shalt thou in his presence rest;
And in communion sweet and free,
Shalt sup with him and he with thee.

title: Dziko Labwino
writer: Edgar Page Stites / John R. Sweney
verses: Ndapeza dziko lokoma, Ndi zinthu zonse ndi zanga;
Mphepo zinunkhira bwino, Za mitengo ya dzikolo,
Mphepo za kumadzulozo, Ndi nyimbo kumwambako,
Angelo onyezimira Ayimba za mphamvu zace.
chorus: O, dzikolo, lokomalo, Pa phiri lokometsalo,
englishVerses: There is a land of corn and wine,
And all its joys will soon be mine;
There shines undimmed one blissful day,
For earth’s dark night has passed away.
My Saviour then will walk with me;
O sweet communion that will be!
He’ll gently lead me by the hand,
In that celestial, happy land.
A sweet perfume upon the breeze,
Will come from ever vernal trees,
And flowers that never fading grow,
Where streams of life forever flows.
The zephyrs then will laden be,
With sounds of sweetest melody,
As angels, with the ransomed throng,
Join in the sweet redemption song.
englishChorus: O Beulah land! Sweet Beulah land!
Upon thy heights I long to stand,
And view the radiant, jasper sea,
And mansions fair, prepared for me,
And find on that eternal shore,
My heaven, my home, for ever-more.

title: Codala Cikondi
writer: John Fawcett / Hans Georg Nägeli (arr. Lowell Mason)
verses: Ciyanjano ca akristu, Cifana ca mwamba.
Pa mpando, wa Mlungu, Wathu tipemphera;
englishVerses: Blest be the tie that binds,
Our hearts in Christian love!
The fellowship of kindred minds,
Is like to that above.
Before our Father’s throne,
We pour our ardent prayers;
Our fears, our hopes, our aims are one,
Our comforts and our cares.
We share our mutual woes,
Our mutual burdens bear;
And often for each other flows,
The sympathizing tear.
When we asunder part,
It gives us inward pain;
But we shall still be joined in heart,
And never part again.

title: Dzuwa Moyowe
verses: Dzuka moyo wanga, Cotsa mantha ako;
Nsembe ya mwaziwo, Cifukwa ca ine;
Indiimira ku mpando, Indiimira ku mpando;
Mzimu ubvomera mwazi, Mzimu ubvomera mwazi,
englishVerses: Arise, my soul, arise,
Shake off thy guilty fears;
The bleeding Sacrifice,
In my behalf appears;
Before the throne my Surety stands,
Before the throne my Surety stands,
My name is written on his hands
He ever lives above,
For me to intercede;
His all redeeming love,
His precious blood to plead;
His blood was shed for all our race,
His blood was shed for all our race,
And sprinkles now the throne of grace.
Five bleeding wounds he bears,
Received on Calvary;
They pour effectual prayers,
They strongly speak of me;
“Forgive him, O, forgive!” they cry,
“Forgive him, O, forgive!” they cry,
“Nor let the contrite sinner die!”
The Father hears him pray, His dear, anointed One;
He would not turn away, The presence of his Son;
His Spirit answers to the blood,
His Spirit answers to the blood,
And tells me I am born of God.

title: Idza Kwa Yesu
verses: ’Dza kwa Yesu lero, lero, ’dza kwa Yesu,

title: Palibe Dzina Lina
verses: Dzina lokhalo la Yesu, Ndilo dzina lokoma;
Dzina lokha ndi la Yesu, Pamene ndibvutika;
Dzina lokha ndi la Yesu pamene ndikondwera.
Ngat’ afuna ngwire ntchito, M’munda wace wa mpesa,
Kuli bwino Yesu yekha, ’Dalitse ntchito zanga.
Ngat’afuna kuti ndife, Akhudze thupi langa,
Kukhale bwino ndi Yesu, Ndikhulupira mwa’ye.
chorus: Dzina, dzina, Palibe longa la Yesu,
Dzina, dzina, Palibe longa la Yesu.
englishVerses: There’s no other name like Jesus,
‘Tis the dearest name we know
‘Tis the angels joy in heaven,
‘Tis the Children’s joy below.
There’s no other name like Jesus,
When the heart with grief is sad;
There’s no other name like Jesus,
When the heart is free and glad.
‘Tis the hope that I shall see Him,
When in glory He appears,
‘Tis the hope to hear His welcome,
That my fainting spirit cheers.
If He wills that I should labor,
In His vineyard day by day,
Then ‘tis well if only Jesus,
Blesses all I do or say.
If He wills that death’s could finger,
Touch feeble, mortal clay,
Then ‘tis well if only Jesus,
Is my dying trust and stay.
englishChorus: Sweet name…… dear name,
(Sweet name)         (dear name)
There’s no other name like Jesus;
Sweet name…      dear name,
(Sweet name)      (dear name)
There’s no other name like Jesus.

title: Mnenere Yesu Liu
verses: Mnenere Yesu liu; Bwenzi la pamtima,
chorus: Mau pang’ono pokha, Nenga, yimba, pempha.

title: Yesu Mnzarete Apita
verses: Cikhamuci cifunanji Coyenda motanganidwa. Cosankhana tsiku ntsiku? Ndiuzenji acitanji?
Yesuyo ndani? Wakuti agwedeza mudzi conci?
Mlendo cabe waluntha Kugwedeza anthu conci?
Yesu! Pansi natsikira Ngati munthu nayendapo;
Lero ayenda ponsepo Tiona mapazi ace;
Ayenda m’nchito zathuzo, Adza kwathu kudzakhala;
englishVerses: What means this eager, anxious throng,
Which moves with busy haste along,
These wondrous gatherings day by day?
What means this strange commotion, pray?
In accents hushed the throng reply;
“Jesus of Nazareth passeth by,”
In accents hushed the throng reply,
“Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.”
Who is this Jesus? Why should he,
The city move so mightily?
A passing stranger has he skill,
To move the multitude at will?
Again the stirring notes reply,
“Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.”
Again the stirring notes reply,
“Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.”
Jesus! ‘tis he who once below,
Man’s pathway trod, ‘mid pain and woe;
And burdened ones where’er he came,
Brought out their sick, and deaf, and lame,
The blind rejoiced to hear the cry;
“Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.”
The blind rejoiced to hear the cry;
“Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.”
Today, as then, from place to place,
His holy footprints we can trace;
He pauseth at our threshold, may,
He enters, condescends to stay.
Shall we not gladly raise the cry:
“Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.”
Shall we not gladly raise the cry:
“Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.”
Ho! All ye heavy laden, come!
Here’s pardon, comfort, rest, and home;
Ye wanderers from the Father’s face,
Return, accept his proffered grace.
Ye tempted ones, there’s refuge nigh:
“Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.”
Ye tempted ones, there’s refuge nigh:
“Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.”

title: Nkhosa Zambiri M’Kholamo
verses: Ndipo ponse pa phiri ndi m’dambo,

title: Chimo Musalole
englishVerses: Yield not to temptation, For yielding is sin,
Each victory will help you, Some other to win.
Fight manfully onward, Dark passions subdue,
Look ever to Jesus, He’ll carry you through.
Shun evil companions, Bad language disdain,
God’s name hold in reverence, Nor take it in vain.
Be thoughtful and earnest, Kind-hearted and true,
Look ever to Jesus, He’ll carry you  through.
To him that o’er cometh, God giveth a crown,
Thro’ faith we shall conquer, Tho’ often cast down
He who is our Saviour, Our strength will renew,
Look ever to Jesus, He’ll carry you through.
englishChorus: Ask the Saviour to help you, Comfort, strengthen, and keep you;
He is willing to aid you, He will carry you through.

title: Kulira Sikanthu
chorus: Yesu nafa pa mtanda, Yesu nandiferatu,

title: Wocimwa Iwe, Bwera
writer: Come Every Soul By Sin Oppressed
englishTune: Come Every Soul By Sin Oppressed
verses: Wocimwa iwe, bweratu, Kwa Yesu, Mbuyeyo;
Ambuye Yesu anatsira Mwazi wace pyu,
Wa moyo ndiye Yesudi, Zoona zacezo,
chorus: Khulupira mau ace onse a Mbuyathuyo,

title: Mbusa wa Israyeli
verses: Mbusa wa a Israyeli, Wocititsa cidwi;
Ife tiri anu omwe, Ana’thu ndi anu.

title: Ndikusowani Yesu
verses: Mlendo wopanda malo, Za dziko ndilibe.
Kundiuzane Yesu, Ndi Mwana wa nkhosa.
englishVerses: I need Thee, precious Jesus, For I am very poor;
A stranger and a pilgrim, I have no earthly store.
I need the love of Jesus, To cheer me on my way,
To guide my doubting footsteps, To be my strength and stay.
I need the heart of Jesus, To feel each anxious care;
To tell my ev’ry trial, And all my sorrows share,
I need the Holy Spirit, To teach me what I am
To show me more of Jesus, To point me to the Lamb
I need Thee, precious Jesus, I hope to see Thee soon
Encircled with the rainbow, And seated on thy throne.
There, with Thy blood-bought children, My joy shall ever be,
To sing Thy ceaseless praises, To gaze my Lord, on Thee! Amen.

title: Mulungu Munathangata
verses: Mwa mthunzi wa mpando wanu, Ndimo tibisala

title: Olimba Ngati Thanthwe
verses: Olimba gwa ngati thanthwe; Ace a Yehova.
Phiri ndi khoma kulibe, Lofanana naye;
Langwiro mwa ilo lokha, Akunja sangalione.
Khulukirani anu, kwa zolakwa zao zonse,

title: Chikhulupiriro Cimodzi Ca Moyo
verses: Lamulo la Mulunguli, Sicinthu copanda pace;
Ndi lokhalitsa myayadi, Simau cabe, ndi moyo.
Langwiro mwa ilo lokha, Akunja sangalione.
Khululukirani anu, Kwa zolakwa zao zonse,
englishVerses: God’s law demands one living faith,
And not a crowd of lifeless creeds;
Its warrant is a firm “God saith”
Its claim not words but living deeds.
O Lord, forgive thy holy law,
Grows tarnished in our earthly clasp;
Pure in itself, without a flaw,
It dims in our too worldly grasp.
Forgive the sacrilege, and take,
From every soul the unholy stain;
And help us for thy Son’s dear sake,
To keep thy perfect law again.

title: Tidzakomana Kodi?
writer: Horace L. Hastings / Elihu S. Rice
verses: Makomanso nga yasipi, omangidwa ndi Mbuye?
Tikakomana ndi Yesu Potenga anthu ace;
englishVerses: Shall we meet beyond the river,
When the surges cease to roll?
Where, in all the bright forever,
Sorrow ne’er shall press the soul?
Shall we meet in that blest harbor,
When our stormy voyage is o’er?
Shall we meet and cast the anchor,
By the far, celestial shore?
Shall we meet in yonder city,
Where the tow’rs of crystal shine?
Where the walls are all of jasper,
Built for us by hands divine?
Shall we meet with Christ, our Saviuor,
When he comes to claim his own?
Shall we know his blessed favor,
And sit down upon his throne?
englishChorus: Shall we meet, shall we meet,
Shall we meet beyond the river?
Shall we meet beyond the river,
Where the surges cease to roll.

title: Dambo La Byula
verses: Ndipitira kunsi kwa dambo la cipululu,
Liri dambo lokongola lochedwa la Byula
Mpulumutsi mwini wace ayenda ndi ine.
Ndiri kunka ndi nsangala ku mzinda wowala,
englishVerses: I am passing down the valley that they say is so lone.
‘Tis to me the vale of Beulah,‘tis a beautiful way,
But I find that all the pathway is with flowers o’er grown,
For the Saviour walks beside me, my companion all day.
Not a shadow, not a shadow ever darkens the way,
And the music, sweetly chanted by the heavenly throng,
For a radiance of rare glory shines upon it all day,
Floats in cadence down the valley, and it cheers me along.
So I journey with rejoicing toward the city of light,
And I near the open portals of the kingdom above,
While each day my joy is deeper, and the path grows more bright,
For this highway leads to heaven, to the kingdom of love.
englishChorus: Vale of Beulah, Vale of Beulah, Thou art precious to me;
For the lovely of the promise, In the distance I see.

title: Dambo Lokongola La Edene
writer: William O. Cushing / William F. Sherwin
verses: Dambo labwino Edene, Muli bata msana;
chorus: Dambo labwino Edene, Kwao kwa odala,
englishVerses: Beautiful valley of Eden,
Sweet is thy noon-tide calm;
Over the hearts of the weary,
Breathing thy waves of balm.
Over the heart of the mourner,
Shineth the golden day,
Waiting the songs of the angels,
Down from the far away.
There is the home of my Saviour;
There with the blood washed throng;
Over the highlands of glory,
Rolleth the great new song.
englishChorus: Beautiful valley of Eden, Home of the pure and blest
(the pure and blest)
How often amid the wild billows;
I dream of thy rest, sweet rest.

title: Kristuu Kapena Barab
verses: Si kwa ocimwa okha Funso linenetse;

title: Mvani Mau A Ambuye
verses: Muli nako kanthu ndi Ambuye ko?

title: Paciyambi Mlunguyo
chorus: Tikondwera podza pa Tsiku la Sabatalo.

title: Mtenderewo
writer: Edward H. Bickersteth / George T. Caldbeck
englishVerses: Peace, perfect peace, in this dark world of sin?
The blood of Jesus whispers peace within.
Peace, perfect peace, by thronging duties pressed?
To do the will of Jesus: this is rest
Peace, perfect peace, with sorrows surging round?
On Jesus’ bosom nought but calm is found.
Peace, perfect peace, with loved far away?
The blood of Jesus whispers peace within.
In Jesus’ keeping we are safe, and they.
Peace, perfect peace, our future all unknown?
Jesus we know, and He is on the throne.

title: tNdidzakutsatani
englishVerses: I will follow thee, my Saviour,
Wheresoe’er my lot may be;
Where thou goest I will fallow;
Yes, my Lord, I’ll follow thee.
Tho’ the road be rough and thorny,
Trackless as the foaming sea;
Thou hast trod this way before me,
And I’ll gladly follow thee.
Tho’ I meet with tribulations,
Sorely tempted tho’ I be;
I remember thou wast tempted,
And rejoice to follow thee.
Though thou lead’st me thro’ affliction,
Poor, forsaken, though I be;
Thou wast destitute afflicted,
And I only follow thee.
Though to Jordan’s rolling billows;
Cold and deep, thou leadest me;
Thou hast crossed the waves before me,
And I still will follow thee.
englishChorus: I will follow thee, my Saviour,
Thou didst shed thy blood for me;
And tho’ all men should forsake thee,
By thy grace I’ll follow thee;

title: Fesa Mbeuu Za Cikondi
writer: Mary Riley Smith / Silas J. Vail
verses: Dzuwa sitisamala Pa nthawi ya cilimwe,
Mwana akacita ngozi Poswa cikho comwera
Kodi pakukwiya naye Mupsa Mtima leroli?
Poganizira za m’mbuyo Za zomwe tinacita,
englishVerses: Let us gather up the sunbeams,
Lying all around our path;
Let us keep the wheat and roses,
Casting out the thorns and chaff;
Let us find our sweetest comfort,
In the blessings of the today,
With a patient hand removing,
All the briers from the way.
Strange we never prize the music,
Till the sweet-voiced bird is flown!
Strange that we should slight the violets,
Till the lovely flowers are gone!
Strange that summer skies and sunshine,
Never seem one half so fair,
As when winter’s snowy pinions,
Shake the white down in the air.
If we knew the baby fingers,
Pressed against the window pane,
Would be cold and stiff tomorrow,
Never trouble us again,
Would the bright eyes of our darling,
Catch the frown upon our brow?
Would the prints of rosy fingers,
Vex us then as they do now.
Ah! Those little ice-cold fingers,
How they point our mem’ries back,
To the hasty words and actions,
Strewn along our backward track!
How those little hands remind us,
As in snowy grace they lie,
Not to scatter thorns but roses,
For our reaping by and by.
englishChorus: Then scatter seeds of kindness,
Then scatter seeds of kindness,
Then scatter seeds of kindness,
For our reaping by and by.

title: Bata Ndu!
verses: Mlengalenga nawonso wada; Kodi tifere m’madzi;
Pamene ife tiri ndi mantha, Kodi tifere m’madzi?
Mbuye bvuto mu mtimamu Landibvuta leroli;
Mbuye zobvutazo zatha, Kwagwa bata tsopano,
Kwawalal ngati kalirole, Ngati ndiri Kumwamba;
chorus: Namondweyo andimvera Ine, bata ndu! (Bata ndu!)
Zonse zingondimvera Ine; Batu ndu, bata ndu!

title: Nkhoswe Yathu
verses: Ukoma wonse ndi wace, Cigonjetso conce,

title: Nkana Chimo Nlalikuru
verses: Nkana chimo nlikuru, Nkana chimo nlikuru,
Ali ndi nsisi zambiri, ndi cikondico.
Imva liu lipempha, Imva liu lipempha,

title: Ponya Cingwe Ca Moyo
writer: Edward S. Ufford / George C. Stebbins
englishVerses: Throw out the life-line across the dark wave;
There is a brother whom someone should save;
Somebody’s brother! Oh, who then will dare
To throw out the life-line, his peril to share?
Throw out the life-line with hand quick and strong:
Why do you tarry, why linger so long?
See! he is sinking; oh, hasten today And out with the life-boat! Away, then, away!
Throw out the life-line to danger-fraught men,
Sinking in anguish where you’ve never been;
Winds of temptation and billows of woe Will soon hurl them out where the dark waters flow.
Soon will the season of rescue be o’er,
Soon will they drift to eternity’s shore;
Haste, then, my brother, no time for delay,
But throw out the life-line and save them today.
englishChorus: Throw out the life-line! Throw out the life-line!
Someone is drifting away;
Throw out the life-line! Throw out the life-line!
Someone is sinking today.

title: Tsamira Pa Manja A Yesu
verses: Tsamira pa manja a Yesu, Akuthangate athagata;
Tsamira pa manja a Yesu, ’Dzauza njira adzauza;
Tsamira pa manja a Yesu, ’Dzakusamala, kusamala!
Tsamira pa manja a Yesu, Msiyire zonse, zonsezodi!
Mtima wace ngwacikondi, Maso ace sasinza.
chorus: Tsamiratu m’cikondi cace; Tsamiratu, yesa cifundo;
Tsamiratu Iye, m’cikondi cace, Tsamira Iye, yesa cifuno;
Tsamiratu Iyel, yang’ana m’Mwamba, Tsamira Mpulumutsi.
englishVerses: Just lean upon the arms of Jesus, He’ll help you along, help you along;
If you will trust His love unfailing, He’ll fill your heart with song.
Just lean upon the arms of Jesus, He’ll brighten the way, brighten the way;
Just follow gladly where He leadeth, His gentle voice obey.
Just lean upon the arms of Jesus, Then leave all to Him, leave all to Him;
His heart is full of love and mercy, His eyes are never dim.
englishChorus: Lean on His arms, trusting in His love; Lean on His arms, all His mercies prove;
Lean on His arms, looking home above, Just lean on the Savior’s arms!

title: Ndiri Ndi Mbuye
englishVerses: I have a Saviour, he’s pleading in glory,
A dear, loving Saviour, tho’ earth-friends be few;
And now he is watching in tenderness o’er me,
And O that my Saviour were your Saviour too.
I have a Father ; to me He has given,
A hope for eternity, blessed and true;
And soon He will call me to meet Him in heaven,
But oh that He’d let me bring with me, too.
I have a robe; ‘tis resplendent in whiteness,
Awaiting in glory my wondering view;
Oh, when I receive it, all shining in brightness,
Dear friend, could I see you receiving one, too.
To me has been given a peace like a river;
A peace that the friends of this world never knew;
And Christ is the Author, and Christ is the Giver,
And O that his peace might be given to you.
When Jesus has found you, tell others the story,
That my loving Saviour is your Saviour too;
Then that your Saviour will bring them to glory,
And prayer will be answered, ‘twas answered for you
englishChorus: For you, I am praying , For you I am praying,
For you I am praying, I’m praying for you.

title: Kosatha! N’kuti?
writer: John R. Bryant / John R. Sweney
englishVerses: “Eternity! Where?” It floats in the air;
Amid calm or or silence it ever is there!
The question s solemn, “Eternity! Where?”
The question so solemn, “Eternity! Where?”
“Eternity! Where?” Oh! Eternity! Where?
With redeemed ones in glory, or lost in despair?
‘Tis one or the other, “Eternity! Where?”
‘Tis one or the other, “Eternity! Where?”
Eternity! Where?” Oh! How can you share,
The world’s giddy pleasures, or heedlessly dare.
Do aught till you settle, “Eternity! Where?”
Do aught till you settle, “Eternity! Where?”
“Eternity! Where?” Oh! Friend, have a care;
Soon God will no longer His judgment forebear;
This day may decide your “Eternity! Where?”
This day may decide your “Eternity where?”
“Eternity! Where?” Oh! Eternity! Where?
Friend, sleep not, nor take in the world any share,
Till you answer this question, “Eternity! Where?”
Till you answer this question, “Eternity! Where?”

title: M’khola Mwa Ng’ombe
writer: Jesus, My Saviour, To Bethelehem Came
englishTune: Jesus, My Saviour, To Bethelehem Came
verses: M’kola mwa ng’ombe mu Betlemumo, anabadwa ambuyangawo
Mbusa wokoma ndi Mbuyangayo, Nandiitana posocerapo,

title: Tsogolere Muuni
writer: John Henry Newman / John B. Dykes
verses: Kwada ndiri kutari ndi kwathu; Tsogolere
Mu malo monse moipa mpaka mdima watha;
englishVerses: Lead, kindly Light, amid the encircling gloom,
Lead Thou me on;
The night is dark, and I am far from home;
Lead Thou me on.
Keep Thou my feet; I do not ask to see,
The distant scene; one step’s enough for me.
I was not ever thus, nor prayed that
Thou Shouldst lead me on;
I loved to choose and see my path; but now,
Lead Thou me on.
I loved the garish day, and, spite of fears,
Pride ruled my will, Remember not passed years.
So long Thy power hath blest me, sure it still,
Will lead me on;
O’er moor and fen, o’er crag and torrent, till,
The night is gone;
And with the morn those angel faces smile,
Which I have loved long since, and lost awhile.

title: Sinjira Yanga
verses: Sinjira yanga bi, Ngakhale ide bi;
englishVerses: Thy way, not mine, O lord, However dark it be;
Lead me by thine own hand, And chose the path for me.
I dare not choose my lot; I would not if I might;
Choose thou for me, my God, So shall I walk a-right.
The kingdom that I seek, Is thine; so let the way,
That leads to it be thine, Else I must surely stray,
Hold thou my cup of life; With joy or sorrow fill,
As best to thee may seem; Choose thou my good and ill
Choose thou for me my friends, My sickness or my health;
Choose thou my cares for me, My poverty or wealth,
Not mine, not mine the choice, In either great or small,
Be thou my Guide, my Strength, My Wisdom, and my All.

title: Idzani Kuno Kwa Ine
verses: Mtendere ngati mtsinje, cikondi ndi nyimbo
Ndi gori lakufewa tipeza mwa Yesu.
chorus: Ndi wofatsa mtimamo, Mudzapumula m’moyo wanu.
englishVerses: O heart bowed down with sorrow! O eyes that long for sight!
There’s gladness in believing; In Jesus there is light.
Earth’s fleeting gain and pleasure Can never satisfy;
’Tis love our joy doth measure, For love can never die.
Divinest consolation Doth Christ the Healer give;
Art thou in condemnation? Repent, believe, and live.
His peace is like a river, His love is like a song;
His yoke’s a burden never, ’Tis easy all the way.
englishChorus: “Come unto Me, all ye that labor,
And are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
Take My yoke upon you, and learn of Me, for My yoke is easy.”

title: Mfumu Yathu
verses: Nyimbo zathu zokoma, Tadza nazo lero,
TIkonda kumyimbira, Ndi kumva za Iye
englishVerses: Our sweetest songs of gladness, On this delightful day,
We bring to praise the Saviour, Who is the Life, the Way.
He loved the little children, When he was here below;
And thou he’s up in heaven, He loves us yet we know.
We love to sing his praises, And hear the stories told,
Of Him when he was dwelling, In Galilee of old.
He loved the little children, When he was here below;
And thou he’s up in heaven, He loves us yet we know.
O Savour, blessed Saviour, We kneel before thy throne,
And ask that thou wilt help us, To live for thee alone.
englishChorus: We sing...we sing, The praises of our King,
(We sing)... (We sing) (Heav’nly King)
We sing... we sing  The glory of our King.
(We sing)...(We sing)

title: Nyenyezi Yabwino
verses: Nyenyezi yabwino yowala ndi ulemerero wa m’mwamba
Kuwala kwace kotsogoza anzeru napeza mwana
Mau anawadziwitsadi nthawi yafika ya nyenyezi,
Anaitsata yowalayo  Ndi "Kristu nthanda ya m’mawa"
Nafe titsate monga iwo, Muni wa dziko wonenedwa’
Titsate monga iwo, Muni wa dziko wonenedwa;
Titsate mpaka tikafike, Ku Mpumula wa kumwamba.
englishVerses: A beautiful star arose one night,
Divinely it shone with purest light;
Its wonderful rays the wise men led,
To find the Saviour’s lowly bed.
They knew by the word of truth divine,
‘Twas time that the guiding star should shine;
They followed its light which shone afar,
‘Twas Christ, “the bright and morning star.”
We’ll follow its light, like those of old,
The “Light of the World,” by seers foretold;
We’ll follow his light till we shall come,
To perfect rest in heaven, my home.
englishChorus: ‘Tis shining still, ‘tis shining still,
That beautiful star, o’er plain and hill;
‘Tis shining still, ‘tis shining still,
Salvation’s star of God’s good will.

title: Mingoli Zikwi Khumi
verses: Ha! Mingoli ndi maunso Alemekeza m’mwamba;
Ali pa mpando uko; Yesu alamulira
Cikondi canu cosatha, Kwa anthu onse;
Kudzamvetsera tsikulo, m’mwamba ndi dziko zatha’
englishVerses: Hark! Ten thousand harps and voices,
Sound the note of praise above;
Jesus reigns, and heav’n rejoices,
Jesus reigns, the God of love;
See, he its on yonder throne;
Jesus rules the world alone,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Amen.
King of glory, reign forever,
Thine an everlasting crown;
Nothing from thy love shall ever,
Those whom dost seal thine own;
Happy objects of thy grace,
Destined to behold thy face,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Amen.
Saviour, hasten thine appearing;
Bring, O bring, the glorious day;
When the awful summons hearing,
Heav’n and earth shall pass away!
Then with golden harps, we’ll sing,
“Glory, glory to our King.”
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Amen.

title: Kodi Ndiwe? Kodi Ndine?
verses: Adzadya za ulemelero, Kodi Ndiwe? Kodi ndine?
Podzakondwerera kosatha; Kodi ndiwe? Kodi Ndine?
Nadzalandiratu korona, Kodi ndiwe? Kondi ndine?
Wina adzaonatu Mfumu, Atamasuka ku zadziko,
Nadzakondwa naye k osatha; Kodi ndiwe? Kodi ndine?
Nadzamvatu, Sindikudziwa, Kodi Ndiwe? Kodi ndine?
Ndipo sadzalandira mphotho; Kodi ndiwe? Kodi ndine?
Pamodzi ndi owomboledwa, Kodi ndiwe, kodi ndine?
Wina adzakakondwerera, Ndi okondedwa pa dookolo,
Ataomboledwa kosatha; kodi ndiwe? Kodi ndine?
englishVerses: Some one will enter the pearly gate;
By and by, by and by,
Taste of the glories that there await,
Shall you? Shall I? Shall you? Shall I?
Some-one will the streets of gold,
Beautiful visions will there behold,
Feast on the pleasures so long foretold
Shall you? Shall I? Shall you? Shall I?
Some one will gladly his cross lay down;
By and by, by and by,
Faithful, approved, shall receive a crown,
Shall you? Shall I? Shall you? Shall I?
Some one the glorious King will see,
Ever from sorrow of earth be free,
Happy with Him through eternity;
Shall you? Shall I? Shall you? Shall I?
Some one will knock when the door is shut,
By and by, by and by,
Hear a voice saying, “I know you not;”
Shall you? Shall I? Shall you? Shall I?
Some one will call and shall not be heard,
Vainly will strive when the door is barred,
Some one will fail of the saints’ reward;
Shall you? Shall I? Shall you? Shall I?
Some one will sing the triumphant song,
By and by, by and by,
Join in the praise with the blood-bought throng,
Shall you? Shall I? Shall you? Shall I?
Some one will greet on the golden shore,
Loved ones of earth, pain and parting o’er,
Safe in the glory forevermore;
Shall you? Shall I? Shall you? Shall I?

title: Popita Masikuwa
englishTune: While The Days Are Going By
verses: Dziko liri m’cisoni, Misozi ndi maliro;
Modzi ndi mmodzi atsala, Popita masikuwa
englishVerses: There are lonely hearts to cherish,
While the days are going by;
There are weary souls who perish,
While the days are going by;
If a smile we can renew,
As our journey we pursue,
O, the good we all may do,
While the days are going by.
There is no time for idle scorning,
While the days are going by;
Let your face be like the morning,
While the days are going by;
For the world is full of sighs,
Full of sad and weeping eyes;
Help your fallen brother rise,
While the days are going by.
All the loving links that bind us,
While the days are going by;
One by one we leave behind us,
While the days are going by,
But the seeds of good we sow,
Both in shade and shine will grow,
And will keep our hearts aglow,
While the days are going by.
englishChorus: Going by,       going by,       Going by,      going by,
(Going by)       (going by)        (going by)     (going by)
O, the good we all may do,
While the days are going by!

title: Alipo Malo Opuma
writer: Near To The Heart Of God
englishTune: Near To The Heart Of God
verses: Alipo malo okoma, Mfupi ndi Mulungu,
Pakukomana ndi Mbuye Mfupi ndi Mulungu.
Alipo malo okwana, Mfupi ndi Mulungu;
Chimwemwe ndi mtenderewo, Mfupi ndi Mulungu
chorus: O! Yesu Mpulumutsi, Mtima wa Mulungu,

title: Nditengeni
verses: Ndifuna kuona nthawi Yonkha ku Ziyoni,Komwe tidzakhala bwino, Ku mudzi wa Yesu.
Ndi mpando wa mfumu yanga Yemwe ’natilenga.
Ndifuna ku Yerusalemu, Ku mudzi wa Mfumu,
chorus: Ku mudzi wachikondiwo. Ku mudzi wa Yesu.

title: M’Mayesoro Anga
englishVerses: In the hour of trial, Jesus, plead for me,
Lest by base denial I depart from Thee;
When Thou see’st me waver, With a look recall,
Nor, for fear or favor, Suffer me to fall.
With forbidden pleasures,
Would this vain world charm;
Or its sordid treasures,
Spread to work me harm;
Bring to my remembrance,
Sad Gethsemane,
Or, in darker semblance,
Cross-crowned Calvary.
Should Thy mercy send me,
Sorrow, toil, and woe,
Or should pain attend me,
On my path below,
Grant that I may never,
Fail Thy hand to see;
Grant that I may ever,
Cast my care on Thee.

title: Anadzatu Kwa Yesu
englishTune: They Brought Their Gifts To Jesus
verses: Anadzatu kwa Yesu ndi mphatso zaozo,
Ndi Mtima wa cikondi Natula zonsezo
Ndi zopereka zao Ndizo za mtengotu.
chorus: Tulani mphatso zanu kwa Yesu Mbuyeyo
Pereka Mtima wanu Pa guwa lacelo.
englishVerses: They brought their gifts to Jesus,
And laid them at His feet,
And love for this dear Saviour,
Made every offering sweet;
Good deeds and words of kindness,
Help for the poor of earth,
And not a gift among them,
Was thought of little worth.
Apart from other givers,
A poor way-farer stood;
He saw the gifts they offered,
The poorest counted good,
And he was filled with longing,
A gift, though poor to bring;
Alas! All empty- handed,
He stood before the King.
“Dear Lord,” he cried in sorrow,
“I know kind Thou art,
Take all I have to give Thee,
My sinful way-ward heart;”
Then Jesus answered softly,
”Count not the gift as small,
Though all of them are precious,
Thine is the best of all.”
englishChorus: Wouldst bring a gift to Jesus,
That He will count most sweet?
Say “Lord, my heart I give Thee,”
And lay it at His feet.

title: Mundilandiretu
writer: Eliza H. Hamilton / John H. Stockton
verses: Kwa Inu YEsu ndilira; Wopanda Inu ndidzafa;
Ndine wocimwa kwambiri, Koma munafera ine;
englishVerses: Jesus, my Lord, to thee I cry;
Unless thou help me I must die;
Oh, bring thy free salvation nigh,
And take me as I am.
Helpless I am, and full of guilt,
But yet thy blood for me was spilt;
And thou canst make what thou wilt,
But take me as I am.
No preparation can I make,
My best resolves I only break;
Yet save me for thine own name’s sake,
And take me as I am.
I bow before thy mercy seat,
Behold me, Saviour, at thy feet;
Thy work begin, thy work complete,
And take me as I am.
If thou hast work for me to do,
Inspire my will, my heart renew;
And work both in, and by me, too,
And take me as I am.
And when at last the work is done,
The battle fought, the vict’ry won;
Still, still my cry shall be alone,
Lord, take me as I am.
englishChorus: Take me as I am, Take me as I am,
Oh, bring thy free salvation nigh,
And take me as I am.

title: TIkondwera Pakugwira Ntchito
writer: Gladly, Gladly, Toiling For The Master
englishTune: Gladly, Gladly, Toiling For The Master
verses: Tikondwera pakugwira ntchito ya Ambuye mofunitsatu
Yomwe mbuye wathu watipatsa, Tidzacita molimbikatu
Mokondwra tidzanena nthano ya cikondi cace m’dzikoli
Mu ulemerero wa Atate at ipatsa madalitso ’ce
Pomtsatira Mbuye wathu Yesu, Pakuyenda naye m’njiramo,
Tidzatsogolera otaika, kuti anke kwa Ambuyeyo.
chorus: Pakugwira ntchito yace, timakondwatu, E, timakondwatu,
Pakugwira ntchito yace m’munda wa Ambuyeyo

title: Timanja Tiwiri
verses: Timanja tigwire ntchito yace, Lilime limlemekeze,
Makuatu amve mau ace, Mau ayimbetu nyimbo
Timapazi tiyende m’njirayo, Yopita nayo kumwamba;
Timaso tiwerenge Bible, Linena cikondi cace.
Kamtima ndipereke kwa Yesu, Apulumutse moyowu
Kuti ndigwire ntchitoyace, Ndikhaletu wace konse.
englishVerses: I’ve two little hands to work for Jesus
One little tongue his praise to tell,
Two little ears to hear his counsel,
One little voice a song to swell.
I’ve two little feet to tread the pathway,
Up to the heavenly courts above;
Two little eyes to read the Bible,
Telling of Jesus’ wondrous love.
I’ve one little heart to give to Jesus,
One little soul for him to save;
One little life for His dear service,
One little self that he must have.
englishChorus: Lord, we come, Lord, we come,
In our childhood’s early morning,
Lord, we come, Lord, we come,
Come to learn of thee.

title: Agogoda Ndaniyo
writer: Harriet Beecher Stowe / George F. Root
englishVerses: Knocking, knocking, who is there?
Waiting, waiting, O how fair!
‘Tis a Pilgrim, strange and kindly,
Never such was seen before;
Ah! My soul, for such a wonder,
Wilt thou not undo the door?
Wilt thou undo the door?
Knocking, knocking, still He’s there,
Waiting, waiting, wondrous fair;
But the door is hard to open,
For the weeds and ivy vine,
With their dark and clinging tendrils,
Ever round the hinges twine,
Ever round the hinges twine.
Knocking, knocking, what! Still there?
Waiting, waiting, grand and fair;
Yes, the wounded hand still knocketh,
And beneath the thorn-wreath’d hair,
Beam the patient eyes, so tender,
Of thy Saviour waiting there;
Wilt thou keep him waiting there?

title: Yang’ana Yesu
verses: Yang’ana Yesu wosacimwa; Tate wampatsa moyo wace,
Moyo wa imfa, ndi wa tsoka, Wandibveka ndi moyo wace,
Zocimwa zanga zinampweteka, Chimo nloopsa lofiira,
Ndayeretsedwa ndi mauwo Ndalemerera mwa Ambuye.
chorus: Moyo wacewu, Woyeretsa; Ine ndadziwa moyo wace;
Moyo wa tsoka ndi wa imfa Moyo wangwiro ndabvekedwa
englishVerses: Look upon Jesus, sinless is He;
Father, impute His life unto me,
My life of scarlet, my sin and woe,
Cover with His life, whiter than snow.
Deep are the wounds transgression has made;
Red are the stains, my soul is afraid,
O to be covered, Jesus, with Thee,
Safe from the law that now judgeth me!
Longing the joy of pardon to know,
Jesus holds out a robe white as snow;
“Lord, I accept it! Leaving my own,
Gladly I wear Thy pure life alone.”
Reconciled by His death for my sin,
Justified by His life pure and clean,
Sanctified by obeying His word,
Glorified when returneth my soul.
englishChorus: Cover with His life, whiter than snow,
Fullness of His life then shall I know;
My life of scarlet, my sin and woe,
Cover with His life, whiter than snow.

title: Munditsogolere Mbuye
verses: Thanthwe langa ndi Inu, Ndikabvutika m’moyo;
englishVerses: Saviour, lead me lest I stray,
Gently lead me all the way;
I am safe when by thy side,
I would in thy love abide.
Thou the refuge of my soul,
When life’s stormy billows roll;
I am safe when thou art nigh,
All my hopes on thee rely.
Saviour, lead me till at last,
When the storm of life is past;
I shall reach the land of day,
Where all tears are wiped away.
englishChorus: Lead me, lead me, Saviour, lead me, lest I stray;
Gently down the stream of time,
Lead me Saviour, all the way.

title: Macimo Atsala Pa Mtanda
verses: Mmodzi nalola kufa m’malo mwa ine,
Nyimbo iri pakamwa ndi mu mtimanso,
chorus: Zocimwa pa mtanda, Zocimwa pa mtanda,
Pa mtandapo Yesu! Anasenza macimo anga.
englishVerses: There was one who was willing to die in my stead,
That a soul so unworthy might live,
And the path to the cross, He was willing to tread,
All the sins of my life to forgive.
He is tender and loving and patient with me,
While He cleanses my heart of its dross,
But “there’s no condemnation;” I know I am free,
For my sins are all nailed to the cross.
I will cling to my Saviour and never depart,
I will joyfully journey each day,
With a song on my lips and a song in my heart,
That my sins have been taken away.
englishChorus: They are nailed to the cross,
They are nailed to the cross,
O how mush He was willing to bear!
With what anguish and loss,
Jesus went to the cross!
But He carried my sins with Him there.

title: Ndiribe Zanga, Zonse Nzanu
englishTune: None Of Self And All Of Thee
verses: Ine ndiribe canu Ine ndiribe canu,
Zina n’zanga ndi zanu, Zina n’zanga ndi zanu,
Mtimabe unati "Zina n’zanga zina ndi zanu."
Tsiku ndi tsiku cifundo cace cinanditsitsa,
Ndicepe ine ndithu, mukule Inu Mbuye,
Cokwera kuposa myamba, Kuya kuposa Nyanja
Cikondi canu caposa Tiribe kanthu n’zanu
englishVerses: O the bitter shame and sorrow, That a time could ever be,
When I let the Savior’s pity Plead in vain, and proudly answered: “All of self, and none of Thee!”
All of self, and none of Thee, All of self, and none of Thee,
When I proudly said to Jesus: “All of self, and none of Thee!”
Yet He found me; I beheld Him Bleeding on the accursèd tree,
Heard Him pray, “Forgive them, Father!” And my wistful heart said faintly: “Some of self, and some of Thee!”
Some of self, and some of Thee, Some of self, and some of Thee,
And my wistful heart said faintly: “Some of self, and some of Thee!”
Day by day His tender mercy, Healing, helping, full and free,
Sweet and strong, and, ah! so patient, Brought me lower, while I whispered: “Less of self, and more of Thee!”
Less of self, and more of Thee, Less of self, and more of Thee,
Brought me lower, while I whispered: “Less of self, and more of Thee!”
Higher than the highest heaven, Deeper than the deepest sea,
Lord, Thy love at last hath conquered; Grant me now my supplication—None of self, and all of Thee!
None of self, and all of Thee, None of self, and all of Thee,
Lord, Thy love at last hath conquered: None of self, and all of Thee!

title: Tikondwere Nthawi Zonse
verses: Dzanja  lace litsogoza, Ngati chimo lidzatu
Ndipo mtambo wa cisoni, Udzaletsa cimwemwe.
chorus: Tikondwere nthawi zonse Ponse dzuwa liwala
englishVerses: Let our hearts be always cheerful;
Why should murmuring enter there,
When our kind and loving Father,
Makes us children of His care.
With His gentle hand to lead us,
Should the pow’rs of sin assail,
He has promised grace to help us;
Never can His promise fail.
When we turn aside from duty,
Comes the pain of doing wrong;
And a shadow, creeping o’er us,
Checks the rapture of our song.
Oh! The good are always happy,
And their path is ever bright;
Let us heed the blessed counsel,
Shun the wrong and love the right.
englishChorus: Always cheerful, always cheerful,
Sunshine all around we see;
Full of beauty is the path of duty,
Cheerful we may always be.

title: Mpumulo Kwa Otopa
writer: Samuel Y. Harmer / John W. Dadmun
verses: Kwao Mkristu kwa ulemu, Ndi malo a mpumulo;
Koma m’kati mwa mtendere, Ndidzabvala korona
Adzapfuula mokondwa Pa tsiku la mdzukiro
chorus: Mpumulo kwa otopa, Mpumulo kwa otopa,
Patsidya pa Yordano, M’minda ya Edeneyo
englishVerses: In the Christian’s home in glory,
There remains a land of rest
And my Saviour’s gone before me,
To fulfill my soul’s request.
He is fitting up my mansion,
Which eternally shall stand,
For my stay shall be transient,
In that holy, happy land.
Pain or sickness ne’er shall enter,
Grief nor woe my lot shall share;
But in that celestial center,
I a crown of life shall wear.
Death itself shall then be vanquished,
And its stung shall be withdrawn;
Shout for gladness, O ye ransomed!
Hail with joy the rising morn.
Sing, O sing, ye heirs of glory,
Shout your triumph as you go;
Zion’s gates will open for you,
You shall find an entrance through.
englishChorus: There is rest for the weary,
There is rest for the weary,
There is rest for the weary,
There is rest for you.
On the other side of Jordan,
In the sweet fields of Eden,
Where the tree of life is blooming,
There is rest for you.

title: Ambuye Ali Pafupi Kudza
verses: Ndiponso nyenyezi zikuzima, Tsopano ndi mbanda kucatu
Ndi za pa dziko zinena kuti Ambuye wayandikira
Ndi nthawi yoti kunyada kuthu Mu mpingo wonsewo;
Ndi kwa omveka a dziko lino; Onsewo afulumirenso.
chorus: Ee! Tsopano ndi mbanda kuca ndithu!

title: Mulungu Wa Kumwamba
verses: Akunja ndi Akhristu mwapulumutse ndi kuunika koturuka munomu.

title: Kale Anthu M’kholamo
writer: Who Is He In Yonder Stall?
englishTune: Who Is He In Yonder Stall?
verses: M’munda muna ndaniyo, Mwazi wace dotho do?
chorus: Ndiye Mbuye, Mfuma yanga, Ndiye Mbuye, wakumwamba,

title: Atate Wa Kumwambako
verses: Atate wa kumwambako, Munaombla ife ndi
Atate, Mwana, Mzimunso, Ndinu atatu mmodzitu,

title: Yesu Adzaweruzatu
verses: Wace ufumu ukhala Mpaka ku nthawi zonsezo
Ndi ana onse ayimba, Hosana kwa Mulunguyo
Ndi dzina lace likwera Mongatu nsembe mmwambamo
Ndi anthu onse pansipo Alemekeze Mfumuyo,
Ndipo angelo ayimba, Ayankhe onsewo, Amen.

title: Munthu Wa Zisoniyo
verses: Munthu wa zisoniyo, Timcha dzina lacelo,
Anakwera mmwamba du! Aleluya, ndinu Yesu

title: Polenga Dzikoli
verses: Mumve pemperoli, Ndipo pamenepa, Palibe mauwo, Muwaletu.
Kupatsa moyowo, Kuona m’masomo, pa anthu onsewo, Muwaletu.
Mzimu woonadi, Ndi wa cikondico, Idzanitu
Mwamba mulengemo, Pali za mdimazo, Pa dziko ponsepo, Muwaletu
Malengedwewo, Mdima ukhalamo, Mutume mauwo Muwaletu

title: Ndiyenda Naye Yesu Mbuye
verses: Ndiyenda naye Yesu Mbuye, Ndikondwa nthawi zonsezo
Ndipeza ciyanjano caceco, Ndikwanitsidwa ndi Iye.
Ndiyenda naye Yesu Mbuye, Ndicite cifuniro ’ce.
Ndiyenda naye Yesu Mbuye, Ndabvomereza chimolo,
Pamodzi tidzayenda konseko, Mu ciyanjano caceco.
chorus: Ndiyende naye Yesu Mbuye, Ndifuna atsogoze ’ne
Pokagamira pa Mplumutsiyo Sinditaika konse bi

title: Ndifuna Kukhala Ndi Yesu
writer: I Want To Live Closer To Jesus
englishTune: I Want To Live Closer To Jesus
verses: Ndifuna kukhala ndi Yesu, Kuyang’ana nkhope yace,
Adzaze mtimanga cisomo cace, Ndifuna kukhala naye.
Ndifuna kukhala ndi Yesu, Kumtsata pafupifupi
Ndi kuti ndimvetse polankhula ’Ye, ponena lonjezo lace.
Ndifuna kukhala ndi Yesu, Pafupi masiku onse
Pogwiratu dzanja la mphamvu yace, Nkalowa m’ufumu wace.
chorus: Khala pafupi, mfupi nd Yesu, Pa mbali ya Iyeyo;
Kuyang’ana pa nkhope yabwinoyo, Ndifuna kukhala naye.

title: E, Mzimuu Wa Mulungu ’Nu
writer: O Spirit Of The Living God
englishTune: O Spirit Of The Living God
verses: E, Mzimu wa Mulungu, ’Nu, Mukhale m’mtimanga;
Ndi zangazo ndipatsatu Kwa Inu, Mbuyanga
Sin’funa kanthu kena bi, Mndidzaze, mtimamo,
Mutsuke Mtima wangawo, Ndi mwazi wanuwo.

title: Pa Ubatizo
verses: Aphe nthawi zonse Ndi kudya mauwo.

title: Mmene Ine Ndiri Mwana
writer: I Will Early Seek The Saviour
englishTune: I Will Early Seek The Saviour
verses: Mmene ine ndiri mwana Ndzaphunzira zacezo;
Ndidzamtsata Yesu yekha, M’njira ya mabvutoyo
Ndzanka komwe andiuza Sinnacepe konse bi,

title: Tiri Otumika
verses: Tisatsate dziko lino, koma Yesu mwini
Tionetse za cikondi ndi cisomo cace.

title: Anakwatira Kale
verses: Akhale ndi kudala Pa banja pawopo.

title: Tsiku La Sabata
chorus: Kukumbutsa ife za mphamvu ya kulengayo.

title: Ndidzayimba Za Mulungu
verses: Ndidzayimba za Mulungu Za Kukonda kwaceko
Wandipatsa moyo wace, Moyo wakuyera mbu,
Ine ndiri mwana wace, Wandilera inetu.
Ndipititsa mbiri yace, Ya kukonda kwaceku.
chorus: Inde ndidzayimba nyimbo, Ya kukonda kwaceko,
Yimbatu, ndiyimba nyimbo; Kondako, kondako, yimbatu;
Angelo omwe, Akukala m’mwambamo, E, M’mwambamo.

title: Yesu Wathu Mbuyeyo
verses: Inde m’tima mwanumo ndi mtendere wacewo.
Wanditsuka ine mbu m’mtima mwanga momwemo.
chorus: Yimba kawiri ndi kawirinso, Yesu Ambuye sakanatu,
Mvetsa, mvetsadi, E, wabwinowo, Wakucimwa adzetu,

title: Mvamva Mau A Mulungu
verses: Pelekeni Mtima wanu, Kwa Mulungu wathuyo,

title: Mau Ngonyozekatu
writer: Words Are Things Of Little Cost
englishTune: Words Are Things Of Little Cost

title: T’yimbe Nyimbo Yotikondwetsa
writer: Let Us Sing A Song That Will Cheer Us
englishTune: Let Us Sing A Song That Will Cheer Us

title: Pakupempha Ife Pano
verses: Podziwitsa m’tima mwanga, bwratu kwa Mbuyeyo
M’dziko lino pansi pano sukapeza kanth;umo
Kokkwanitsa Mtima wako, bweratu kwa Mbuyeyo.
Ayeretsa moyo wako nao mwazi wacewo.

title: Mpingo Wa Akristu ’Fe
verses: Mpingo wa Akristu ’fe, tikondwra mwa Ambuye
Tinka m’dziko labwino, tikondwera mwa Ambuye.

title: Alikuitana Uko Tsidyalo
verses: Tamva kuitana tsidya lijalo, Tumiza mauwo,
Tipereke za cifundo zathuzo, Tumiza mauwo.
Mzimu wa Ambuye anke ponsepo, Tumiza mauwo.
chorus: Tibukitse mau acewo, Ndi mitima yonseyo
Tuma mau a uthengawo, Kuli konse amvetu,
Tuma mau a uthengawo, Osaleka konse bi.
Tibukitse mau acewo, Ndi mitima yakufunatu,
Pakumlemekeza Mlunguyo, Ndi kusunga mau acewo
Tuma mau a uthengawo, Kuli konse amvetu,
Tuma mau a uthengawo, Osaleka konse bi.

title: Ndikonda Kuti Atate
writer: I Am So Glad That Our Father
englishTune: I Am So Glad That Our Father
verses: Ndikondwa kuti Atate wathu, Atidziwitsa cikondi cace,
Pakuwerenga m’kalata mwace, Yesu, amati akonda ine.
Andikondabe masiku onse Ndikabwereranso kwa Iyeyo
Ndzayimba kosalekeza konse, Ndikondwa Yesu akonda ine.

title: Lemekeza Mlungu Tate
writer: Groly Be To God The Father
englishTune: Groly Be To God The Father
verses: Lemekeza, Mlungu Mzimu, Mlungu Mmodzi mkuruyo;
Lemekeza Mfumu yathu, Mfumu, Mlengi wathuyo,
Apambana anthu onse, Pansi ndi kumwambako;

title: Tamani Mlungu Mtimamo
writer: Praise The Lord, O My Soul
englishTune: Praise The Lord, O My Soul
verses: Pa mtanda pace pomwepo, Pakundifera inenso.
Ndiribe ntchito zangazo, Kukoma Mtima wangawo
Tsono mubwere inunso, Mombolo wanu ndiyedi

title: Pakukhala Pa Mgonero
verses: Pakukhala pa mgonero, Wa Ambuye wathuyo,
Nkana singaone Inu, Muli mfupi nafedi,
Mutiuze ife nthano Ya mabvuto anuwo,
Mtikokere mfupi ndi ’Nu, Ndi ku mtanda wanuwo,
Pakucoka pa mgonero, Wa Ambuye wathuyo,
Moyo wathu ufanane, Ndi wa Mbuye wathuyo,

title: Tikagwidwa Ndi Cisoni
verses: Mmene imfa yathu idza, Mwenya wathu ukaleka
Mnamwalira Inu paja, Mwazi wanu munataya,

title: Mmene Ine Ndisauka
verses: Mnene ine ndisauka Ndi zoipa zangazo
Ngati atsamwali anga sandikonda ine bi.
Pansi pano ndiri mlendo, Kwathu ndi kumwambako,
chorus: Mlungu adzalandira, Iye ndiye Atate wanga,

title: Pofunafuna M’malembo Ace
verses: Momwe tikumva za Ambuye, Bible amati c’ani ko?
Pofunafuna m’malembo ace, Tiri kufuna njirayo
Yonka ku mzinda wopambana, Bible amati c’ani ko?
Kuwatsogoza kwa Ambuye, Bible amati c’ani ko?
chorus: Pita, kafunse, ati Mfumu, Ka’mba ka iwe, ndinetu
Pita, gogoda khomo lace, Komwe udzapumulako.

title: Usikuwo Woyerawo
verses: Mfumu ya Mafumu, Ndi ya anthuwo.

title: Pamene Ndizaukanso
verses: Pamene ndidzaukanso tsikulo, Komwe kulibe mdima konse bi.
Poklomana nawo okondedwawo Omwe mwa imfa nandisiya ’ne,
Ndidzamuona Yesu posacedwatu, Iye amene nandifera ’ne

title: Utsegule Pa Khomo
verses: Utsegule pa khomo, kuti Yesu alowe;

title: Taya Zobvuta Zako
verses: Taya zobvuta zako, Taya zobvuta zako
Ambuye adzacotsa zonsezo, Taya zobvuta zako.

title: Mdzaze ’Ne Ndi Mzimu
verses: Mdzadze ’ne ndi Mzimu, Mzimu wanu, Mbuye.

title: Usiku Unowu
writer: Lord, Keep Us Safe This Night
englishTune: Lord, Keep Us Safe This Night

title: Mmene Tipita Kwathu
verses: Mmene tipita kwathu, Mbuye, Mutidalitse m’njira zathu;
Mtisogolere tsiku lonse, Kuti tilowe kumwambako.

title: Ambuye Ali M’nyumba Yace
writer: The Lord Is In His Holy Temple
englishTune: The Lord Is In His Holy Temple
verses: Ambuye ali m’nyumba yace, M’kacisi wace wakuyera,
Akhale cete onse, Akhale cete pa maso pace.
Akhale mwa cete, mu nyumbayi. Amen.

title: Patseni Wina Mbuyanga
writer: Lord, Lay Some Soul Upon My Heart
englishTune: Lord, Lay Some Soul Upon My Heart

title: Yang’anani Kwa Yesu
verses: Ndipo za pa dziko zizimadi, Pakuona kuwala kwace.

title: Mu Mtimanga
verses: Mu mtimanga, mu mtimanga, Lowani, Ambuye Yesu
